tool_input.command:
echo "=== sibling projects ==="; ls -1 /Users/anhnm/dev/01.Github/ 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo; echo "=== languages in those projects ==="
for d in /Users/anhnm/dev/01.Github/*/; do
  n=$(basename "$d")
  langs=""
  [ -f "$d/package.json" ] && langs="$langs node"
  [ -f "$d/tsconfig.json" ] && langs="$langs TS"
  [ -f "$d/requirements.txt" ] || [ -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ] && langs="$langs py"
  [ -f "$d/go.mod" ] && langs="$langs go"
  [ -f "$d/Cargo.toml" ] && langs="$langs rust"
  [ -f "$d/pom.xml" ] || [ -f "$d/build.gradle" ] && langs="$langs java"
  ls "$d"*.sln "$d"*.csproj >/dev/null 2>&1 && langs="$langs csharp"
  ls "$d"*.xcodeproj >/dev/null 2>&1 && langs="$langs xcode"
  [ -n "$langs" ] && echo "  $n:$langs"
done
echo; echo "=== global toolchains ==="
for c in node npm pnpm bun python3 go cargo dotnet java; do printf "%-8s " "$c"; command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 && $c --version 2>&1 | head -1 || echo "-"; done
tool_input.description: Detect user's usual languages and installed toolchains
